correctness.rationale: The scalar quadratic normalized gradient equals the sign of the iterate, reducing SNGM to an exact piecewise-affine recurrence. For every sign word, the momentum and displacement are explicit integer polynomials in the momentum parameter. A full-state return requires two polynomial equations. Exact exhaustive reduction through length six leaves no admissible root below period six and exactly the two stated period-six roots. The open initial intervals satisfy every sign inequality, and direct package replay verifies the return and average-gradient identities.

value.rationale: The defining SNGM theory deliberately permits constant learning rates and consequently retains an order-\(\eta\) stationarity term. The accepted result shows that this floor corresponds to exact recurrent dynamics on the simplest strongly convex objective, rather than merely proof slack. Classifying the shortest source-initialized returns completely, including the two algebraic momentum resonances and continuum initial intervals, gives a natural structural benchmark for normalized-gradient momentum methods.
